patches.reason: Forward Action.Value to the same c_union.Value helper without a generic function alias.
Use explicit scalar comptime dimensions, a data-derived bounded name buffer and an explicit comptime map-construction block while preserving X11 parser, sort, lookup, names, order and RGB values.
Widen verified ASCII vector lanes into the same u32 output one lane at a time; preserve vector scan, fallback decoder, counts, and error handling without requiring a single four-times-wider vector.

Express the same packed field-path mask traversal recursively with const intermediate types instead of a mutable comptime type and split iterator; retain source offsets, types, widths and union checks.
Share the unchanged color-scheme encoded byte selection between the real Writer encoder and its comptime maximum; avoid constructing and invoking a discarding Writer at comptime.

Make XTGETTCAP construction explicitly comptime; preserve every capability response, uppercase hex digit, u32 decimal value, control/parameter escape rule, sentinel and StaticStringMap runtime lookup using source-order helpers and exact byte copies instead of incidental comptime Writer machinery.
Retain public Parser.next while evaluating the unchanged ordered exit/transition/entry actions into caller-owned storage with the original deferred state update.

Use bounded caller-owned parser action output in the actual stream path; preserve transition observation, action order, payload borrowing and dispatch without per-byte retained array-return allocations.

Derive the exact maximal DECRPM report size from the same maximal Report, decimal digit counts and unchanged encoder framing lengths; preserve the real runtime encoder while avoiding incidental comptime Discarding Writer construction.
Result-locate the unchanged DCS hook switch in ?Hook before returning success from !?Hook; preserve all branches, scopes, allocation tries and caller-visible failure handling.

Retain unconditional comptime duplicate-key rejection via unreachable, allowing the interpreter to evaluate its data-dependent guard before rejecting. Original sorting, table construction, keys and lookup remain unchanged; duplicate diagnostic becomes unreachable instead of the custom message.

Give cursorCopy hyperlink ID its existing optional const-byte-slice result type explicitly; preserve both original union branches, borrowed memory, empty IDs, null and startHyperlink behavior. Avoid general capturing-switch optional peer inference for this incidental local.

Pass RGB r, g and b as the same ordered positional Writer arguments for foreground/background DECRQSS attribute encoding. Preserve decimal bytes, framing, channel order and Writer error propagation while avoiding incidental named-argument reflection.

Materialize the same fixed-size wide-cell/spacer interleave by source-order lane assignments instead of std.simd.interlace comptime vector-mask machinery. Preserve all lanes, vector arithmetic, loop bounds, packed cell stores and scalar tail.

Declare the same two color-scheme values and c_int/u1 target-dependent backing explicitly instead of a generic enum factory. Preserve C/Zig ordinals, size/alignment, exhaustive tags, pointer representation and exact Writer report bytes/errors. The compiler diagnostic type name becomes the ordinary ColorScheme declaration; this avoids reproducing Zig generic-argument diagnostic pretty printing for the reached callback signature.

Declare Size with the same four fields as an explicit extern struct for terminal_options.c_abi and an ordinary struct otherwise. Preserve C/Zig field order, types, size/alignment, actual field offsets and unchanged Writer report encoding/error behavior. Nominal/reflection names become those of the ordinary conditional Size declaration instead of a generic Struct factory instance or anonymous factory argument; avoid generic-argument diagnostic name printing in the reached callback signature.
